title: Integrate every rich component workflow
description: Wire each supported rich node through semantic editing, persistence, autosave, undo/redo, scene generation, previews, PDF output, backup registration, and structured diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Each rich node can be added, named, configured, removed, and reordered with semantic keyboard-operable controls
All node edits persist through autosave and reload and participate in session undo/redo
Every supported node resolves through the shared scene into label preview, sheet preview, and PDF adapters
Asset references are registered for future complete-workspace backup without embedding transient URLs
Unsupported, missing-resource, and overflow failures identify the component and block partial PDF success

steps.details: Reuse the existing editor state seam to expose add, hierarchy, property, remove, reorder, and keyboard overlay-position controls for all supported nodes.
Route rich-tree edits through existing autosave and undo/redo commands and register durable asset identities in project serialization.
Map every node to application-owned scene nodes and diagnostics consumed unchanged by label preview, sheet preview, and the isolated PDF renderer.
Build one mixed nested label by keyboard, preview it, undo/redo, reload, generate PDF, and assert missing/overflow states are announced and atomic.

technicalNotes: Keep the implementation pass to one thin vertical wiring increment under ten minutes; use existing generic editor and adapter registries rather than bespoke UI per node.
Backup registration is metadata wiring only; complete export/import behavior belongs to PRD 24.
